The '''Sack of Sacks''' is a [[Bag]] that can store [[Sacks]]. It's unlocked at {{Coll|Tropical Fish 4}} and can be upgraded through the {{Coll|Tropical Fish}} collection and [[Account & Profile Upgrades]]: it is accessed from the [[SkyBlock Menu]].

== Usage ==
The '''Sack of Sacks''' allows players to store different [[Sacks]]. Extra slots can be obtained through {{Coll|Tropical Fish}} [[Collection]] and [[Account & Profile Upgrades]].

{{/UI}}

== Trivia ==
*Multiple sacks of the same type can be placed into the Sack of Sacks.
**However, different sacks that can store the same item do not merge their storages. For example having both {{Item|Large Lava Fishing Sack}} and {{Item|Large Mining Sack}} will leave the player with the regular {{Green|20,160}} base storage for {{Item|Coal}}.
